guitar.notes: Munky and Head are both well documented Ibanez 7-string signature artists (K7/APEX/HSH series), iconic to nu-metal sound.

tone.target: detuned nu-metal crunch with scooped mids and tight low-end
tone.profile: detuned nu-metal crunch with scooped mids and tight low-end
tone.summary: A heavy, aggressive signal chain utilizing a Recti-style amp model with Distortion/Fuzz pre-gain, paired with a 4x12 cabinet to achieve the necessary detuned chug and modern high gain.
corrections: raise gain to modern high gain
emphasize detuned chug over generic crunch

rig.name: Korn - Got The Life (2) - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain noise and hum inherent in modern metal tones.
Provide aggressive initial saturation and tighten the low end for palm-muting.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is used to simulate a tight, modern high-gain preamp stage (like an early Recti boost) without excessive mid-range bloom.

blocks.purpose: Add extra punch and sustain to the chug without altering the core scooped frequency response.
blocks.gap: Using 'Boost' as a secondary gain stage for maximum tightness, mimicking an aggressive pedal boost into the amp model.

blocks.purpose: Provide the core modern high-gain tone, emphasizing low frequencies and achieving scooped mids.
Simulate a powerful, aggressive cabinet suitable for modern metal tones.
blocks.gap: While 'UK Vintage 4x12' is available, the 'Mess 4x12' often provides a more open and aggressive voicing better suited for nu-metal chug.

blocks.purpose: Aggressively scoop the mids and tighten the low-end response for maximum chug.
Included as a potential subtle texture layer for verses, but kept mostly off to maintain aggression.
blocks.gap: The Chorus is generally avoided in this genre, so it is set inactive. It remains available if a slight atmospheric element is desired.

blocks.purpose: Add a subtle sense of space and depth without muddying the aggressive low end.
blocks.gap: A very short, controlled reverb is needed; 'Room' provides this better than Plate or Spring for modern metal.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and overall low-end punch for detuned nu-metal chug.

proposals.recommendedAsset: High-power 4x12 IR (e.g., Mesa Boogie or similar)
proposals.reason: Enhance the aggressive, tight low-end required for nu-metal chug.
